title: OSCON 2011:  Karen Sandler
summary: Karen Sandler, then Executive Director of the GNOME Foundation, talks at OSCON 2011 about the risks of proprietary, closed-source software in implanted medical devices like her own pacemaker-defibrillator.
why: Brought up whenever medical device security or open-source firmware in implants is discussed.

quote.text: on her experience trying to navigate the issue of getting a pacemaker-defibrilator, including fairly serious security concerns
